name: webcam
description: A bare webcam: a 90 x 30 x 30 mm body and its lens, looking straight down, the middle of the lens's front face at the origin. A camera added to a site is drawn as this, turned and tilted as it is aimed.

source.title: webcam, a bare body and lens
source.author: Quaternion Media
source.note: Built in OpenSCAD to a typical webcam's size; no mesh of anyone's was used.
